inputs.sequence_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1>: Celes performing Maria: the exact blonde adult woman with blue hair ribbon, ivory puff-sleeved opera gown, blue waist sash and blue trim. Keep her face and costume.
<Picture 2>: Setzer: the exact mature man with long silver hair, facial scar, black long coat with blue collar, gold brocade waistcoat, ivory cravat, black gloves and tall boots.
<Picture 3>: Locke: the exact adult man with brown hair, blue bandana, short dark jacket, cream embroidered shirt, blue trousers and tan boots.

summary:
A single continuous fifteen-second cinematic live-action opera scene with real actors and the approved practical character designs.

retention_analysis:
Retain the exact referenced faces, hairstyles, costumes, proportions and materials. Images define identity; directed blocking determines the scene. No unlisted actors or face replacements.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] (0-15 seconds) One uninterrupted cinematic live-action wide three-quarter view from the Blackjack airship deck toward the short boarding gangway and the theatre service doorway. The ship is moored beside the theatre at blue hour, at the same height as the doorway. Dark brown deck planks, brass rail with wooden top, one waist-high wooden hinged boarding gate at the gangway's deck end on screen left, cabin door at screen right, rope ladder at far right. The short solid wooden gangway has fixed handrails on both sides and a flush stable junction to the deck. The theatre doorway and its steady warm light remain visible behind it. Fixed diffuse blue sky and steady warm deck lanterns, constant exposure, natural skin and matte fabric. No flashing lights, no luminous scenery, no ocean voyage or takeoff. Keep one coherent ship and a stable floor throughout.
All three people are established from the first frame. Setzer and Celes are near the deck end of the gangway, Setzer half a step ahead with his LEFT hand holding her RIGHT hand. The boarding gate is already open inward, leaving a clear passage. Locke is visible farther back at the theatre doorway, watching and waiting; his single round wooden shield stays lowered in his LEFT hand, and his sheathed belt weapon and costume remain unchanged. His route from that doorway across the gangway is always visible. Celes has no bouquet. Setzer's cards remain stowed.
0-5 seconds: Setzer and Celes take three grounded steps through the already open gate onto the deck. Show weight passing between their feet, their coats and gown following their bodies. The joined hands stay between them, with no switching sides. Celes turns her eyes back along the gangway toward Locke while keeping her body moving with Setzer. Locke notices her glance and leans slightly forward, ready to follow.
5-8 seconds: The couple stops just inside the deck. Celes gently releases Setzer's hand, gestures once with her RIGHT hand toward the cabin at screen right and looks there. Setzer follows her gesture, turns his shoulders and takes one step toward that cabin. Celes then turns back toward the boarding gate and reaches its upper edge with her LEFT hand.
8-12 seconds: The wooden gate begins to swing slowly toward its latch; Celes catches it with her left palm and pushes it open again on its visible hinges, holding it for Locke. In response, Locke walks the short remaining length of the gangway, passes through the open gate and steps onto the deck, keeping his shield lowered and clear of the rails. Celes watches his passage. No actor or object may pass through solid rails, the gate or another body. Preserve the same gate panel, hinges, handrail and threshold throughout.
12-15 seconds: Locke stops beside the brass rail one step inside the gate. Celes releases the gate after he clears it and faces Setzer. Hearing Locke's last boot step, Setzer turns his head, then his torso back toward both of them and stops. His confident expression shifts to alert curiosity. Celes stands calmly between their lines of sight, preparing to speak in the next take. All three are now clearly on the same deck. The shield stays in Locke's left hand, no new weapon is drawn. The camera backs away a short smooth distance on the deck during the boarding and settles for this triangular confrontation, keeping the gangway and gate legible; no orbit, internal cut or teleport.

overall_soundscape:
Native diegetic sound only: distinct boot steps on wooden gangway and deck, gown and coat fabric, a quiet gate hinge, light rigging and subdued evening wind. Exactly no intelligible speech in any language, no narration, no singing. All three mouths remain silent.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
